registered_before: the omitted-process verdicts are applied. Disclosure: the owner stated this rule before seeing the completed summary, but it reached the session after the summary and the cross-check had been computed (all 180 common records agree to max relative difference 6e-16 on F_ion(N2+ -> N3+), F_S(N2+ destruction) and max n(N2+)/n(N2)). The rule therefore could not have been shaped by a discrepancy; none exists.

rule.status_of_runs: Earlier and later envelope run sets are not independent physics datasets. Their common metrics are an implementation-consistency check only.
rule.authoritative_set: The newest run set (the one carrying the full metric list) is authoritative. Run sets are never averaged, and no set is selected by preference.
rule.discrepancy: Any discrepancy in a common metric large enough to alter a threshold verdict must be investigated and resolved before the completeness rule is applied.

application.verdict_rule: addendum 1 applied literally: U < T -> EXCLUDE; L > T -> PROMOTE; L < T < U -> UNCERTAINTY VARIANT. No judgment adjustment for values close to a threshold.
application.closure_table: one row per process: primary criterion, lower / nominal / upper, worst case, transport-sensitive, chemistry-sensitive, verdict
